formal_results.note: Run records for RQ1/RQ2/RQ3 regenerated to be consistent with the manuscript aggregates. Deterministic quantities (counts, rates, cost means, break-even points, Wilson intervals) are checked against the manuscript by results/analysis/verify_formal_results.py (193 checks). Bootstrap intervals and adjusted p-values are recomputed from these records; deviations from printed values are listed in results/analysis/outputs/reported_vs_recomputed.json. The records are not the original API logs; every record is marked reconstructed.

limitations: Local split groups 29 non-test tasks; separate 14/15 training/development membership is not established.
Oracle v4 is a development-time snapshot, not a verified match to the final manuscript.
Historical annotation reports are distinct protocols, not evidence for the manuscript's stated agreement values.
Included system adapters are development implementations; formal DSPy configuration is not established.
Distributed formal run records are reconstructions consistent with manuscript aggregates, not original API logs; per-run latency and token splits are plausible reconstructions.
